description: Replace the image background or surrounding environment while preserving the foreground subject's identity, shape, colour, position, scale, and main lighting relationships.
Change the material or surface property of the target object, for example ceramic, wood, metal, glass, or fabric, while keeping the object's shape and position and all non-target regions unchanged.
Replace the specified subject with a different kind of object or person, while preserving every other element of the scene.

Remove the specified object or local element and inpaint the background behind it naturally, without damaging adjacent objects, text, or layout. When choosing the removal target, always pick the most salient, clearly bounded subject in the scene; avoid tiny, distant, or visually insignificant elements.

Insert a new object of an explicitly specified kind at a stated location in the scene, blending it naturally into the scene's structure, lighting, and perspective, while preserving every existing element.
Apply a cartoon, oil-painting, pixel, or similar style transfer to the specified object only, keeping the background and all other objects in their original style.
Change the target object or region to an explicitly specified new colour while keeping its shape, material, lighting, and all non-target regions unchanged.
Change the surface texture of the target object, for example smooth, rough, glossy, or matte, while keeping its shape, colour, and position unchanged.

Extract one clearly identifiable object, garment, worn item, or independent part from the actual BEFORE image and present it alone on a clean neutral background while preserving its visual identity. When choosing the extraction target, prefer salient, large-area subjects; avoid small, inconspicuous objects.
Change a specified text fragment to explicitly given new content with character-level accuracy, while preserving all non-target text, the typeface, and the layout.
Completely remove the specified text and inpaint the region it occupied naturally, while preserving all other text and the layout.
Add explicitly specified new text at a stated location with correct content, size, colour, alignment, and legibility, without adding any other text.
Translate the specified source-language text in the image into an explicitly stated target language, replacing the original text while preserving its meaning, position, and visual styling.
Replace an entire specified text block with another explicitly given passage, keeping spelling, digits, and punctuation exact, and preserving the original visual attributes.
Move or re-arrange the position of text blocks, while preserving every other element of the scene.
Change the weight, italics, underline, colour, or typeface style of the specified text while keeping its content and all non-target elements unchanged.
Change the person's pose or action to an explicitly specified new action while preserving their identity, appearance, the scene, and anatomically plausible body structure.
Change the person's hairstyle, clothing, or a specified appearance attribute while strictly preserving facial identity, age, skin tone, pose, and expression.
Apply light, natural retouching, skin smoothing, or skin-tone adjustment while preserving the person's identity, facial feature positions, proportions, and realistic skin texture.
Convert the entire image into an explicitly specified artistic or visual style while keeping the main objects, text content, structure, and semantics recognisable.
Reorganise the overall composition and positions of the objects or text already present in the image, while preserving every other element of the scene.
Change the overall environment or background into an explicitly specified new scene while preserving the main people or objects along with their identity, pose, and position.
Change the main light direction, intensity, colour temperature, or time-of-day atmosphere, and re-derive shadows, reflections, and overall illumination plausibly.
